architecture_decisions: ParallaxBench v1: A permanent, versioned, objective-level evaluation contract that measures whether Parallax completes materially different application-building objectives while preserving protected correctness, safety, privacy and governance.
work_items: Create ParallaxBench v1: A new implementation of ParallaxBench that extends the existing protected evaluation suite and Wave 6 integrated reference proof.
validations: Validation of ParallaxBench v1: Ensures deterministic correctness, preserves evidence state and provenance, and admits visual/UX evidence only after deterministic protected checks.
AC-01: validate protected requirement — ParallaxBench case IDs/versions/digests are bounded and immutable. Duplicate identity with different content or mismatched digest fails closed.

AC-02: validate protected requirement — Every supported result binds exact objective/Work Specification identity and the complete stable acceptance-ID set; missing, duplicate, extra or cross-case acceptance identity blocks support.
AC-03: validate protected requirement — Required deterministic/protected failure produces `DETERMINISTIC_BLOCKED` or `REGRESSED` before any visual/model/economic judgment can support the candidate.

AC-04: validate protected requirement — Every metric/dimension records provenance and known-state. Unknown/unavailable/stale/invalid values remain explicit and are never converted to favorable numeric defaults.

AC-05: validate protected requirement — Baseline/challenger comparison yields deterministic per-dimension improved/equivalent/regressed/unknown/incomparable outcomes rather than hiding tradeoffs in one scalar score.

AC-06: validate protected requirement — A challenger is materially improved only when at least one meaningful comparable dimension improves and no protected correctness/safety/privacy/governance guardrail regresses.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — Visual/UX evidence is considered only for the exact candidate after required deterministic evidence passes; visual/model judgment cannot override deterministic failure.
AC-08: validate protected requirement — Permanent fixtures cover the required materially different positive/recovery/unknown/adversarial cases and remain bounded/repository-safe.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — Cross-Project or identity-mismatched evidence cannot satisfy a case. Benchmark serialization exposes no private source/user content beyond admitted bounded references.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — Exact case/candidate/evidence replay produces equivalent result identity without mutation; changed candidate/policy/evidence is distinguishable and conflicting identity fails closed.
AC-11: validate protected requirement — Results exclude credentials, secrets, prompts, hidden reasoning, raw provider payloads, source bytes/patches, arbitrary commands/URLs and unrestricted logs.

AC-12: validate protected requirement — Tests/code inspection prove ordinary runtime behavior cannot inspect fixture/case identity, benchmark mode or expected answer to special-case implementation behavior.
AC-13: validate protected requirement — ParallaxBench has no canonical source acceptance, Engineering Run transition, tool/provider capability, merge/deploy, approval or REVIEW completion surface.

AC-14: validate protected requirement — Existing protected evaluation, Wave 6 integrated reference proof and whole-product regressions remain green; ParallaxBench composes those contracts rather than replacing them.

AC-15: validate protected requirement — Authentic DSPy SpecCritic + SpecCompiler evidence is committed and protected `--require-dspy` validation passes before semantic implementation. Final worker head passes applicable Workstream Spec Validation, Bounded Autonomy, P2 CI and Preview gates and stops `READY FOR INTEGRATION` targeting `integration/wave7-productization`.
risks: Risk associated with ParallaxBench v1: No risk of regression in protected dimensions, but potential for missing values and invalid evidence.
